βοσκομένη: βόσκω — feed, pasture; mid. graze; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (of the hind grazing)
διιπετέος: διιπετής — fallen from the sky, sky-fed (Διός + πίπτω); adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., standing epithet of a great river
δύσεο: δύω — go into, enter; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -σεο (Attic δῦσαι), + acc.: ’go in among’
ζεφύρῳ: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. dat. sg.
ζηνός: Ζεύς — Zeus; gen. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνός = Διός)
θάμ: θαμά (elided θάμ’) — often, again and again; adv.
θνητὸς: θνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ἀνήρ
κέχυτο: χέω — pour, spread; plpf. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέχυτο): ’lay spread out’
κληῗσιν: κληΐς — thwart, rowing-bench (also thole-pin, key, bar); fem. dat. pl., epic -σιν (the diaeresis marks the two syllables) · also hook, clasp of a brooch: ’hooks’ (κληῗσιν ἐϋγνάμπτοις ’well-bent hooks’)
κρήνης: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. gen. sg.
κρατὺς: κρατύς — strong, mighty; masc. nom. sg.
μαχητήν: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. acc. sg.
μυρμιδόνας: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ own troops from Phthia; masc. acc. pl.
πάνθ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom. pl., elided and aspirated (πάνθ’ = πάντα): ’everything’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’all that’ (πάνθ’ ὅσα … μυθήσασθαι ’all that … to tell’)
πηλέος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
πορὼν: πόρω — furnish, give; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having given’
σχέτλιε: σχέτλιος — reckless, cruel; masc. voc. sg.: ’you reckless one!’
φυκτὰ: φυκτός — to be escaped, escapable (verbal adj. of φεύγω); neut. nom. pl.
ἀγειρόμενοι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’gathering (together)’
ἀκάκητα: ἀκάκητα — epithet of Hermes, meaning disputed (’kindly, not harming’ or ’giver of ease’); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
ἀπερείσια: ἀπερείσιος — boundless, without limit; neut. acc. pl.
ἀργεϊφόντης: Ἀργεϊφόντης — ’Argeïphontes’, standing epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’slayer of Argus’; masc. nom. sg.; the meaning is disputed, not actually known
ἔτρεφεν: τρέφω — nourish, rear, cherish; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’was nurturing, cared for’
ἕδνα: ἕδνον — bridal gift (given to the bride’s kin); neut. acc. pl.
ὄπυιε: ὀπυίω — have as wife, be married to, wed; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
ὑπερῷ: ὑπερῷον — upper story, upper chamber; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὑπερῷ’ = ὑπερῷα)
